headline: India Faces Prolonged Food Inflation Across Grains and Dairy
summary: India is experiencing persistent food price inflation across basic staples including grains, chicken, and milk, pressuring domestic consumer spending.
why: Food prices carry a heavy weight in India's consumer price index, influencing Reserve Bank of India policy rates and household purchasing power.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Prolonged food inflation burdens domestic consumers and complicates monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
